suppress.notes: CVE-2026-65898 (CVSS >= 7) in DOMPurify 3.2.4, bundled inside the Swagger UI webjar shipped by springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui 2.8.6 (swagger-ui.js / swagger-ui-bundle.js / swagger-ui-es-bundle.js all embed the same vendored copy). No springdoc-openapi release with a patched swagger-ui/DOMPurify bundle has been verified against this project's OpenAPI setup as of 2026-08-20. DOMPurify has several additional lower-severity CVEs against this bundle that don't cross the CVSS 7.0 gate and are left unsuppressed - they remain visible in the dependency-check report. Review by: 2026-11-18.
